_doc.how: Greetings are code-owned (not editable in the app). Evaluate every rule; keep matches; take the highest priority tier; pick one line at random (seeded by date + rule id so it is stable for the day). A rule matches when ALL of its conditions are true; empty 'when' always matches. Rules using an alias the form does not define are skipped.
_doc.tokens: {{key}} in a line is replaced by the context value of that key.
_doc.aliasKeys: Derived from the form pack 'aliases' over the last 3 days vs baseline: mood3, moodDelta, sleep3Hours, sleepLowDays3 (< 6 h), exerciseDays3, studyDays3, studyMinutes3, water3avg
